title: Friday Night Magic 2005: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows." —Seal inscription
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim." —Sisay
We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.
"We decide who is worthy of our works." —Gix, Yawgmoth praetor
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place." —Ertai, wizard adept
In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.
